factors.label: Power
factors.help: Opponent-adjusted scoring margin, capped so blowouts of bad teams don't count extra.

factors.label: Résumé
factors.help: Strength of record: how many more wins than an average top-25 team would have with this schedule.

factors.label: Efficiency
factors.help: Opponent-adjusted EPA/play and success rate, garbage time removed.

factors.label: Schedule
factors.help: How hard was your road? The average strength of the FBS teams you played, no matter how good you are. FCS games are left out here (they count in Cupcake). Higher = tougher schedule.

factors.label: Recent form
factors.help: How the team has played in its last few games.

factors.label: Cupcake
factors.help: How much did you pad it? Only the games far below YOUR level count: FCS opponents, plus below-average teams 14+ points worse than you (bigger mismatches count more). A bad team playing other bad teams isn't padding. Higher = more padded, and it counts against the team. Only games already played count.

factors.label: Bad luck
factors.help: Higher = has had bad luck: lost games they statistically won, so the record undersells them. Lower = has been winning coin flips.

factors.label: Power
factors.help: Opponent-adjusted scoring margin, capped at 21 so garbage-time scores don't count extra.

factors.label: Résumé
factors.help: Strength of record: how many more wins than a top-8 team would have with this schedule.

factors.label: Efficiency
factors.help: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play (offense minus defense).

factors.label: Schedule
factors.help: How hard was your road? The average strength of every opponent played. Higher = tougher schedule.

factors.label: Recent form
factors.help: How the team has played in its last few games.

factors.label: Cupcake
factors.help: How much did you pad it? NFL teams can't pick cupcakes, but schedules still hand them out. Only games against below-average teams that are worse than YOU count, and the bigger the mismatch the more it counts (full credit at 14+ points worse). A bad team playing other bad teams isn't padding. Higher = more padded, and it counts against the team. Only games already played count.

factors.label: Bad luck
factors.help: Higher = has had bad luck in close games (one-score results are treated as coin flips). Lower = has been winning coin flips.
